channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, AI, Tech & Research, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, AI, Tech & Research, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Zoud GameLab 2026: Global Game Jam financial-literacy jam (prize and funding pool up to USD 140,000)
item.description: Zoud (UAE National Financial Wellbeing and Sustainability Initiative) with Global Game Jam · deadline 15 Nov 2026 · Shared prize and development-support funding pool of up to USD 140,000 across best overall game, runner-up, third place, financial-literacy impact, regional perspective, compelling gameplay and a Best Game from the UAE award; individual prize amounts are not published. No entry fee.

item.title: Judson-Morrissey Excellence in New Media Award 2026 (BIPOC students)
item.description: New Media Caucus · deadline 08 Nov 2026 · Multiple unrestricted awards of varying amounts up to USD 500 each, funded through donor contributions. Awardees are also featured in an NMC Header/Footer Gallery exhibition and a digitally published interview. Free to apply.

item.title: AFTER THE PALACE: Resonance 2026 Video Mapping Contest (Krakow)
item.description: University of the National Education Commission in Krakow (unLoc project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Cash prizes: PLN 10,000 (~EUR 2,340) first place, PLN 6,000 second, PLN 3,000 third; the jury may award additional honorary distinctions or redistribute the pool. Free to enter, submission is exclusively digital.

item.title: American Academy in Rome: Rome Prize Fellowship 2027-28
item.description: American Academy in Rome · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Stipends of USD 16,000 (half-term, about 5 months) and USD 30,000 (full-term, about 10 months), plus housing, workspace and weekday meals. Approximately 30 fellowships per year. APPLICATION FEE: USD 50 by 1 November (USD 60 for multiple categories); USD 80/90 in the late window to 15 November.

item.title: Mozilla Data Collective: Lost in Transcription ASR Challenge
item.description: Mozilla Data Collective (Mozilla Foundation) · deadline 02 Oct 2026 · USD 20,000 total in prizes across three language tracks (per track: USD 4,000 for first place and USD 2,000 for second, plus a bonus award for the lowest average word error rate across all three tracks). No entry fee.

item.title: AI Philosophy Competition: First Edition
item.description: Zachary Goodsell and Elliott Thornley, funded by Forethought Research · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 3,000 first prize, USD 2,000 second, USD 1,000 third, plus a USD 5,000 pool for creative methodology distributed at the judges' discretion (USD 11,000 total). No entry fee.

item.title: Zindi: Bias Bounty Mapping Equity Challenge
item.description: Zindi with Humane Intelligence, Radiant Earth, and the Heising-Simons Foundation · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 10,000 total in prizes: 1st USD 4,500, 2nd USD 2,500, 3rd USD 1,500, Best Bias Discovery USD 1,000, Best Documentation USD 500, plus 10,000 Zindi points. Free to enter.

item.title: ARC Prize 2026
item.description: ARC Prize Foundation · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 2,000,000 total prize pool across three tracks (ARC-AGI-2, ARC-AGI-3 agents, and a paper prize); milestone prizes include USD 25,000 / 10,000 / 2,500

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research prize - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• AI ART AWARD: NEXT ART AI 2026
    https://next-art-ai.com/en/apply/overview
    HOBAN Cultural Foundation · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Total prize pool of KRW 21,000,000 across 20 winners, paid after deduction of applicable taxes and public charges. Grand Prize KRW 5,000,000 (selected regardless of category); in each of the two categories, First Prize KRW 2,000,000, three Second Prizes of KRW 1,000,000 each, and five Honorable Finalist awards of KRW 500,000 each; plus a HOBAN Group President's Award of KRW 1,000,000. Winners also receive plaques and certificates, online and offline exhibition opportunities, and a feature on the official online platform. No entry fee is mentioned.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research prize - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• American Academy in Berlin: Berlin Prize Fellowship 2027-28
    https://www.americanacademy.de/apply/apply-for-a-fellowship/
    American Academy in Berlin · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 5,000, plus roundtrip airfare, accommodation at or near the Hans Arnhold Center, partial board, in-house library services and professional networking opportunities. Roughly two dozen fellowships awarded each year. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research prize - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Berggruen Prize Essay Competition 2026: A New Axial Age?
    https://berggruen.org/eu/essay-competition-open
    Berggruen Institute · deadline 17 Aug 2026 · USD 50,000 for the winning English essay and USD 50,000 for the winning Chinese essay. If there is more than one winner in a language category, the prize is split evenly. Winning essays are published through BI Press or Noema. No entry fee.
